reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so a sachet I can carry doesn't fix anything for me. The lab report is nice, but I'm not scrolling TikTok looking for a new magnesium.
objection: I don't take it on the go, I take it at home before bed. I'd be paying for portability I don't use, and I'd probably forget the box on the counter anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing a real problem I have, like waking up at 3am, where this clearly fixes it better than what I already take, plus the launch price of $24.99.
